name: query
description: Run a read-only SQL query against the Postgres database. Accepts a single SELECT (including WITH ... SELECT), EXPLAIN, or SHOW statement.

name: list_tables
description: List the tables, views, and materialized views this connection can read, with their descriptions.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.desc: Optional. Substring matched in the table name or description.

name: get_table_context
description: Describe one or more tables: columns, types, nullability, primary keys, foreign key targets, enum values, and curated descriptions.

arguments.name: tables
arguments.desc: Table names, ideally qualified as schema.table.
